name: Replacement
description: Represents the replace criteria for a find-and-replace operation. The properties and methods of the Replacement object correspond to the options in the Find and Replace dialog box.
remarks: Use the Replacement property to return a Replacement object. The following example replaces the next occurrence of the word "hi" with the word "hello." To find and replace formatting, set both the find text and the replace text to empty strings ("") and set the Format argument of the Execute method to True. The following example removes all the bold formatting in the active document. The Bold property is True for the Find object and False for the Replacement object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Replacement object.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns or sets a Font object that represents the character formatting of the specified object. Read/write Font.

properties.name: ParagraphFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a ParagraphFormat object that represents the paragraph settings for the specified replacement operation. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets the style for the specified object. To set this property, specify the local name of the style, an integer, a WdBuiltinStyle constant, or an object that represents the style. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text to replace. Read/write String.

properties.name: LanguageID
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdLanguageID constant that represents the language for the specified range. Read/write.

properties.name: Highlight
properties.description: True if highlight formatting is applied to the replacement text. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Frame
properties.description: Returns a Frame object that represents the frame formatting for the specified style or find-and-replace operation. Read-only.

properties.name: LanguageIDFarEast
properties.description: Returns or sets an East Asian language for the specified replacement. Read/write WdLanguageID.

properties.name: NoProofing
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word replaces text that the spelling and grammar checker ignores. Read/write Long.

methods.name: ClearFormatting
methods.description: Removes text and paragraph formatting from the text specified in a replace operation.
